name: FilterPixel
description_en:
FilterPixel combines photo culling and AI editing for high-volume photography. Basic Cull filters technical issues; DeepCull scores photographs using genre-specific criteria and supplies written reasons. Users review the proposed selection, apply built-in or learned editing profiles and export JPEGs or ratings/labels through XMP to other editors.

It fits photographers who must select and edit large shoots while retaining final judgment. It is not just a background-removal app: its measured commercial unit is a DeepCull shoot, while basic culling/editing have different allowances. DeepCull processes low-resolution derivatives in the cloud according to the vendor, so “originals stay local” must not be read as “no image data is transmitted.”
description_zh:
FilterPixel结合批量照片筛选及AI编辑。Basic Cull检查技术问题，DeepCull按题材标准评分并给出文字理由，用户复核选择、应用内置/学习的编辑风格，再导出JPEG或通过XMP把评分/标签交给其他编辑器。

它适合需筛选和编辑大拍摄集且保留最终判断的摄影师，不是单纯去背景工具。商业计量单位为DeepCull拍摄批次，基础筛选/编辑额度不同。厂商表示DeepCull在云端处理低分辨率衍生图，因此“原片留本地”不能理解为“无图像数据传输”。

core_features.explanation_en: DeepCull scores/ranks images by selected genre and leaves the photographer to review final selects.
core_features.explanation_zh: DeepCull按选定题材评分/排序，最终选片由摄影师复核。

core_features.name_zh: 风格配置及可编辑交接
core_features.explanation_en: Built-in/learned AI profiles adjust photos; ratings/labels travel through XMP, with plan-gated JPEG/crop tools.
core_features.explanation_zh: 内置/学习的AI风格调整照片，评分/标签通过XMP交接，JPEG/裁切按套餐限制。

core_features.explanation_en: One DeepCull import covers up to 5,500 photos; larger projects split and use multiple shoots.
core_features.explanation_zh: DeepCull单次导入最多5,500张，大项目拆分并耗多个批次。

sections.title_en: Import, set the genre and review the proposed selection
sections.title_zh: 导入、选题材并复核建议
sections.en:
The [June 2026 walkthrough](https://filterpixel.com/blog/how-to-use-filterpixel-the-complete-feature-walkthrough) imports JPEG/RAW and chooses Basic or DeepCull. Basic focuses on blur/focus/technical grouping; DeepCull uses a genre such as wedding, conference, concert or sport and gives scores/reasons. Its output is a starting selection, not an instruction to delete rejected originals. Magic Number requests a target selection count on eligible Pro/Studio plans.

Review Mode groups bursts and the guide says DeepCull selects at least one frame per burst. Confirm or replace that pick rather than assuming the top score captures the client’s priorities. Survey Mode supports detailed comparison, while camera/lens and moment filters help inspect subsets. An exact requested number or an explanatory score does not prove every chosen image is suitable or every important moment is retained. No accuracy or speed claim was independently measured.
sections.zh:
[2026年6月流程指南](https://filterpixel.com/blog/how-to-use-filterpixel-the-complete-feature-walkthrough)导入JPEG/RAW并选Basic或DeepCull。Basic看模糊/焦点/技术分组，DeepCull按婚礼、会议、演出或运动题材评分/解释，结果是初选起点，不是删除落选原图的指令。符合条件的Pro/Studio可用Magic Number设目标选片数。

Review Mode按连拍分组，指南表示每组至少选1张；应确认或替换，不假定最高分符合客户重点。Survey Mode用于细看，机身/镜头和时刻筛选可检查子集。返回指定数量或解释分数不证明每张合适或重要时刻全保留，本文未独立测量准确性和速度。

sections.title_en: Apply a style and carry decisions to the next editor
sections.title_zh: 应用风格并向下一编辑器交接
sections.en:
The [editing page](https://filterpixel.com/editing) describes built-in profiles and a learned profile from edited Lightroom catalogs. The walkthrough says a custom profile needs around 3,000 consistently edited photos and roughly 24 hours of training; current pricing separately offers unlimited Instant Profiles and limited custom trainable profiles. Those names/requirements should be confirmed in the intended version rather than assumed identical.

The guide documents in-app preview from version 4.3.0 and export to JPEG or Lightroom/Lightroom Classic/Photoshop/Capture One. Ratings and color labels use XMP sidecars for RAW or embedded metadata where supported, rather than altering RAW pixels. Preserve sidecars with originals, confirm catalog metadata import and verify which edit parameters actually travel; rating/label compatibility does not guarantee every crop/color operation is identical in every editor. The price page gates crop/straighten/JPEG delivery to Pro/Studio even though the general guide describes the full workflow.
sections.zh:
[编辑页](https://filterpixel.com/editing)介绍内置配置及从已编辑Lightroom目录学习的风格。流程指南称自定义配置约需3,000张统一风格照片及约24小时训练；当前价格又分别列无限Instant Profiles及有限自定义训练配置，不能默认名称/要求相同，应按目标版本确认。

指南说明4.3.0起可应用内预览，并导JPEG或交Lightroom/Lightroom Classic/Photoshop/Capture One。RAW评分及颜色标签存XMP边车，支持格式可嵌入，不改RAW像素。应连同原图保留边车、确认目录读入，检查哪些编辑参数真正传递；评分/标签兼容不保证每个编辑器裁切/颜色效果完全相同。通用指南介绍全流程，但价格页把裁切/校正/JPEG交付限Pro/Studio。

sections.title_en: A shoot is an import unit, not an arbitrary photo count
sections.title_zh: 批次按导入计，不是任意图片数
sections.en:
One DeepCull shoot is an import session of up to 5,500 photos. The current guide/FAQ says larger imports split automatically: a 10,000-image project uses two shoots and a 7,300-image project becomes 5,500 plus 1,800. Confirm the displayed charge before processing. Basic culling and included editing are advertised without per-photo fees, but DeepCull is metered.

Annual cards list Standard 20, Pro 70 and Studio 140 shoots per year. The FAQ also refers to a monthly allocation/reset at the first of each billing month; these periods are inconsistent in the read page. Do not silently reinterpret an annual 20 as 20 every month. Separately purchased $7.99 extra shoots cover up to 5,500 photos, require no subscription and are described as nonexpiring. Included unused shoots do not roll over under the FAQ, unlike purchased extras.
sections.zh:
DeepCull一批是最多5,500张的导入会话，当前指南/FAQ表示超大导入自动拆分：10,000图耗2批，7,300图拆成5,500加1,800。处理前应确认显示费用。基础筛选和内含编辑宣传无按图费用，但DeepCull按批计。

年付卡片列Standard20、Pro70、Studio140批/年，FAQ却又写月额度及每账单月首日重置，周期不一致。不能擅自把年20解成每月20。另购$7.99批次最多5,500张，无需订阅且称不失效；FAQ表示内含未用批次不结转，与购买额外批次不同。

sections.title_zh: 年付及团队/风格配置额度
sections.en:
The read annual cards display Standard $14.99/month with $180/year billed, Pro $34.99 with $420/year, and Studio $64.99 with $780/year. The billed totals are rounded differently from simply multiplying the displayed monthly equivalents, so retain the explicit totals. Monthly prices, final currency/tax/renewal and precise included-shoot refresh need confirmation.

Standard lists one built-in editing profile/basic cull; Pro adds Magic Number, JPEG export, two custom trainable profiles and one seat; Studio lists five custom profiles, up to five seats and a team dashboard. The matrix/FAQ also says Instant Profiles are unlimited on paid plans, which must be kept distinct from custom trainable profiles. A no-card trial is promoted, while another page says four free projects; exact current trial allowance and expiration were not checked in the app.
sections.zh:
实读年付卡片显示Standard折合每月$14.99、实际年扣$180，Pro为$34.99/$420，Studio为$64.99/$780。总额与月折合乘12的舍入不同，因此保留明确年额。月付金额、最终币种/税费/续费及内含批次刷新需确认。

Standard列一个内置编辑配置/基础筛选；Pro增Magic Number、JPEG、2个自定义训练配置及1席；Studio为5个配置、最多5席及团队面板。矩阵/FAQ还说付费Instant Profiles无限，需与自定义训练配置区分。网站宣传无需卡试用，另一页称4个免费项目，当前准确额度和失效未在应用核查。

sections.title_en: Cloud previews and opt-in profile training are real data flows
sections.title_zh: 云端预览及自愿风格训练是实际数据流
sections.en:
The [privacy policy](https://filterpixel.com/privacy) states that culling processes low-resolution derivatives and metadata to deliver/improve results, not original full-resolution files; intentional catalog submission trains a personalized editing profile. The homepage says those previews are uploaded for cloud analysis. This is compatible with originals staying local and does not establish no cloud processing. Do not generalize “not training on originals” into no use of derivatives or usage data.

The policy describes retaining content during a subscription or until deletion is requested, recommends user backups and says it is not obliged to back up content. Exact retention after cancellation, cloud regions and profile deletion need confirmation. Vendor GDPR/CCPA, encryption and no-third-party-AI statements are policy claims, not independent security evidence. No client images/catalog were uploaded and no network/permission or deletion test was run.
sections.zh:
[隐私政策](https://filterpixel.com/privacy)表示筛选处理低分辨率衍生图和元数据以提供/改善结果，不用原始全分辨率文件；主动提交目录才训练个人编辑配置。首页明确预览图会上传云分析，这与原片本地并存，不能说完全无云处理，也不能把“不训练原片”扩大为不使用衍生图或使用数据。

政策描述订阅期间或请求删除前保留内容，建议自备份且无义务备份，取消后具体期限、云区域及配置删除需确认。GDPR/CCPA、加密及不交第三方AI声明是厂商政策，不是独立安全证据。未上传客户照片/目录，未跑网络/权限或删除测试。

sections.title_en: Selection and delivery remain the photographer’s responsibility
sections.title_zh: 选片及交付仍由摄影师负责
sections.en:
The [terms updated March 27,2025](https://filterpixel.com/terms-of-service) grant a limited platform license and require rights to uploaded content, with a broad service/business content-use grant. They do not establish an open-source software distribution right or a universal refund: unused portions are generally not refunded unless otherwise stated, and refund requests are reviewed. Exact current order/refund terms should be checked for the chosen plan.

Keep original photos, sidecars, final selects and exported deliverables independently. Inspect closed eyes, duplicate moments, sponsor/client requirements and edits before delivery; a score/reason is an aid to judgment. OS support is stated as Windows/Mac with many RAW formats, but exact build/camera/Lightroom/Capture One versions and current hardware requirements were not verified. No download/install, cull/edit, profile training or catalog handoff was executed.
sections.zh:
[2025年3月27日更新条款](https://filterpixel.com/terms-of-service)授予有限平台许可，要求上传权利并有广泛服务/业务内容使用授权，不提供开源分发权或统一退款保证。未用部分原则不退，除非另有规定，申请退款需审查，具体订单/退款应按套餐核对。

应独立保留原图、边车、最终选片及交付，交片前检查闭眼、重复时刻、赞助/客户要求和编辑，分数/理由仅辅助判断。网站表示Windows/Mac及多种RAW支持，但未核实具体构建、相机、Lightroom/Capture One版本及硬件要求。未下载/安装、筛选/编辑、训练或目录交接。

research_gaps.en: No install/import, selection quality, cloud transmission, profile training, edit/JPEG export, XMP handoff or backup/deletion was tested.
